processSection.description: A transparent, milestone-driven process — you pay at each successful stage, not upfront.

steps.title: Free Consultation
steps.description: We genuinely assess your background, goals, and eligibility. No obligation, no upfront fees. If you don't qualify or it doesn't make sense to proceed, we'll tell you honestly — no irresponsible upselling.

steps.title: Pathway Matching
steps.description: We identify pathways that can actually work. Before any contract is signed, you'll see employer profiles and a clear fee schedule — no vague promises.

steps.title: Career Placement
steps.description: Matched with quality employers from our vetted network. We provide genuine sponsorship credentials and authentic employment records that stand up to immigration scrutiny.

steps.title: Ongoing Support
steps.description: We stay by your side from skills assessment and visa lodgement through to receiving your invitation. All legal matters are handled by licensed partner Insight Idea throughout.

employerNetwork.description: Every employer in our network holds a current, active 482/186 sponsorship licence
employerNetwork.detailDescription: Our employer partners prefer to keep their recruitment confidential — we provide full company profiles, available roles, and current sponsorship approval status during the consultation. No vague promises, no "mystery" employers.
employerNetwork.disclaimer: Employer profiles are provided during the consultation.
employerNetwork.cta: Book a free consultation to find out which employers are hiring

trustSafety.heading: We know what you're worried about.
trustSafety.subheading: You may have already heard stories like these:
trustSafety.description: Fake job listings, hidden fees that only appear after payment, promises that vanish after a transfer. RedBridge exists to draw a clear line against these practices. Our word is our bond — and you're welcome to verify it yourself.

userScenario.eyebrow: What kind of help do you need most right now?

scenarios.title: I just graduated
scenarios.description: I have an Australian degree, but I do not yet have enough local work experience to apply for migration.

scenarios.title: I need visa sponsorship
scenarios.description: I am a skilled professional or I have work experience, and I am looking for an Australian employer who can sponsor my 482 or 186 visa.

scenarios.title: I want permanent residency
scenarios.description: I want to apply for PR independently through the points-tested skilled migration system.

scenarios.title: My visa is about to expire
scenarios.description: I am short on time and need urgent guidance on bridging visas, visa extensions, or changing visa types.
